Who can post on Instagram for me as a Realtor?

Short answer

A done for you posting service can. LocalLift Signature, from The SocialDM, makes 3 local posts a week for real estate agents, sized for Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn and Google Business, with your headshot, logo, brokerage and contact details on every one. It costs $199 a month, month to month.

The SocialDM · Nov 11, 2026
The problem

What to look for in a posting service

01Local and dated. Real market numbers with the date they came from, plus spots and events in the ZIP codes you serve.
02Your brand, not a template. Your posts should look like you, not like every other agent in your ZIP code.
03A caption for each platform. Instagram, Facebook and LinkedIn readers want different things.
04Set it up once. You approve your headshot, logo and details at sign up, not every post.
What it does not replaceYour own listings, stories and videos. The feeds that work best mix both: a steady local presence from us, your personality from you.
FAQ

Questions we hear

Do I have to approve every post?

No. You approve your brand details once when you sign up, and the posts come every week after that.

Is there a contract?

No. It is month to month, and you can cancel anytime.

Can I still post my own content?

Yes, and we recommend it.
